node.label: Abnormal hyoid bone morphology
node.definition: Any structural abnormality of the hyoid bone (hyoid), a small U-shaped (horseshoe-shaped) solitary bone, situated in the midline of the neck anteriorly at the base of the mandible and posteriorly at the fourth cervical vertebra.

evidence.snippet: Brachytelephalangic chondrodysplasia punctata: Abnormal hyoid bone morphology (frequency HP:0040283) [TAS]
